site.meta_description: ReadRoll keeps your books and board games organized. Scan barcodes, build your wishlist, and track your whole collection, no spreadsheet needed.

footer.tagline: Read it. Play it. Track it.

landing.page_title: ReadRoll – Your books and board games, organized

hero.title: Read it. Play it. Track it.
hero.subtitle: For readers and players.
hero.description: Keep your books and board games organized. Know what’s on your shelves, plan your next one, and say goodbye to spreadsheets.

track.title: Track your collection
track.description: Manage your books and board games, and always keep track of them.

organize.title: Organize your way
organize.description: Add items to your collection and tag them to keep everything organized.

scanner.title: Add a book in seconds
scanner.description: Scan the barcode, check the details, save. That’s it.

wishlist.title: Build your wishlist
wishlist.description: Keep the books and games you want in one list, so you never miss one.

langs.title: Speaks your language
langs.description: Available in English and French. Switch anytime.

beta.question: How can I join the beta?
beta.response: Access is by invitation only for now. Send an email to {email} and we’ll get back to you.

suggest_feature.question: Can I suggest a feature?
suggest_feature.response: We’d love to hear your ideas! Email {email} with your suggestion.

price.question: Is ReadRoll free?
price.response: Yes, ReadRoll is free during the beta. Later on, we may offer optional paid features, but the core app will stay free.

data_privacy.question: Is my data safe?
data_privacy.response: Your collection is private: only you can see it. Your data is stored on secure servers in France and backed up regularly. We never sell or share your data.

import.question: Can I import my spreadsheet?
import.response: Not yet, but it’s on our roadmap. In the meantime, the barcode scanner makes adding books much faster.
